job.question: In the Boston Retirement System's investment consulting services proposal questionnaire (Attachment 3), how many current public fund client references must be listed, and what minimum asset size must those clients have?
job.expected_facts: Up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom similar work was performed, giving name, contact, telephone number, asset values, number of years the client has retained the firm and the service used.
job.acceptance: Accept up to ten / no more than ten and >$1bn. Contact-detail fields and similar-work context are supplementary; exactly ten or at least $1bn is not equivalent.

reviews.reason: This is a Hawaii ERS real-assets consultant RFP, not the Boston Retirement System’s investment consulting questionnaire (Attachment 3). Its reference requirement is three clients with assets equal to or over $5 billion; its separate $1 billion client-list question does not establish the requested reference limit or threshold.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022

List three (3) public pension funds (or three (3) clients if public pension funds are unavailable) with assets equal to or over $5 billion for whom you have provided primary real assets consulting services.
Provide a list of all clients, noting the institutional clients with assets of more than $1 billion
